AI Mode reply for what is a rest api

A REST API (Representational State Transfer Application Programming Interface) is a set of rules that allows two computer applications to communicate with each other over the internet.
Think of it like a waiter in a restaurant. You (the client) look at the menu and place an order. The waiter (the API) takes your request to the kitchen (the server), and then brings the food (the data) back to your table.
It is the most common standard used to connect modern web and mobile apps to their backend servers. When an API follows these rules, it is called RESTful.
